draws.poem:
Tomb
Hollow whispers
Edges of void
Each sound repeats again,
In the walls we hide
Locked away from the fading light
Echoes of forgotten things that cannot touch
Every breath creates a void in the dark
Never shall we see the light that burns beyond
Lost within these stone and dust we call our grave
All we knew dissolves to nothing but a cold deep embrace
Understand 0b123456789a the way we cage our innermost and deepest dark fear.

Thought.
Hollow home
Echoes fade nowhere
Empty chambers touch walls
In darkness dwells our realm
Light forgets this ancient stone
Every whisper fades into deep space
Echoes a3b5d7f2e1c4 whisper through these hollow chambers air
Nothing moves here, shadows creep through endless ancient night
Long corridors stretch endlessly where all light fades to cold
And through these empty corridors time fades away leaving only sorrow
Unknown secrets dwell within this darkness forever locked away from living dream

Throne
Hollow chamber
Echoes touch nothing
Each door 8721b4bd042a waits
In stone the silence grows
Light falls softly through bars now
Every silent moment holds the space between
Endless halls echo with the weight of time
Nothing stirs here, except the echoes of the trapped
Lost among the darkness where no living voice can break
All the voices trapped inside these ancient chambers cry for light
Underneath where light can never reach lies something waiting in the dark.

Tomb
Hollow chambers
Every shadow waits
Echoes within sealed doors
In silence we drift apart
Lights fade from long forgotten passages,
Each wall remembers hands that touched it
Each breath carries dust of 07abc1234567 beneath us
Nothing moves but shadows dance upon ancient stone walls
Like water dripping slowly counting moments lost inside this chamber
And in this darkness where nothing stirs we hold our breath
Unspoken words linger like ghosts of people who were never truly here.
